SaveState.title: SaveState
SaveState.description: Represents an emulator snapshot state for a retro game.

userId.description: The authenticated user ID of the owner.

gameId.description: Unique identifier of the ROM or game.

label.description: Optional label or description of the save state.

thumbnailBase64.description: Base64 encoded thumbnail preview of the screen.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this save state was created. Submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this save state was last updated. Submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User emulator settings and controller skin customizations.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile vibration haptics are enabled.

rewindCapacityFrames.description: Maximum number of history frames retained in the rewind buffer.

audioEnabled.description: Whether chiptune audio output is enabled.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when preferences were updated. Submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/save_states/{saveStateId.description: Per-user save state snapshots for all supported retro platforms.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Per-user settings and controller skin customizations.
